descriptions.enableMsync: Use the Wine build's Mach synchronization path when it supports WINEMSYNC.
descriptions.steamWebHelperArgs: Adds stable Chromium/CEF flags to Steam WebHelper so the Steam UI is more likely to render correctly under macOS Wine.
descriptions.hoyoplayInProcessGpu: Starts HoYoPlay with --in-process-gpu, which helps some CEF windows appear under Wine.
descriptions.enableTimeoutFix: Enables the packaged Wine timeout workaround for launchers that stall during startup.
descriptions.leftCommandIsCtrl: Maps the left Command key to Ctrl inside Wine for games that expect Windows shortcuts.
descriptions.retinaMode: Toggles Wine Mac Driver Retina rendering for sharper UI at high DPI.
descriptions.metalHud: Shows Apple's Metal performance HUD for graphics debugging.
descriptions.dxmtPreferredMaxFrameRate: Writes d3d11.preferredMaxFrameRate into DXMT_CONFIG. Use 60 for HoYoPlay-style fixed FPS; set 0 to remove the cap when DXMT honors that value.
descriptions.dxmtMetalFxSpatialUpscale: Enables DXMT_METALFX_SPATIAL_SWAPCHAIN for DXMT's MetalFX spatial upscale path.
descriptions.dxmtMetalFxSpatialUpscaleFactor: Writes d3d11.metalSpatialUpscaleFactor into DXMT_CONFIG when you want DXMT to upscale the swapchain.
descriptions.earlyExitWaitMs: How long the launcher waits before treating an immediate Wine exit as a startup failure.
descriptions.superviseWaitSeconds: How long launcher-side supervision waits for routed child processes.
descriptions.networkGate: Uses the HoYo network gate workaround for games that need a controlled reconnect window.
descriptions.networkGateSeconds: Duration of the network gate window in seconds.
descriptions.waitForManualNetworkCut: Waits for the user to cut the network manually before continuing a routed launch.
descriptions.autoNetworkCut: Allows launcher helper logic to cut and reconnect the host network automatically.
descriptions.autoNetworkReconnectSeconds: Seconds to wait before reconnecting after an automatic network cut.
descriptions.allowDuplicateGame: Allows the supervisor to start a game even if a matching game process is already tracked.
